speaker: VIKRAM
text: Call an ambulance.   [Old Man's lips move a half-second ahead]

speaker: OLD MAN
text: Not yet. Before you ask for help, answer me.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: What is heavier than the earth?

speaker: VIKRAM (low; desperate)
text: If you can do anything, then take...

speaker: OLD MAN (softly; finishing it)
text: ...you. Instead of them. They all offer that.

speaker: RADIO
text: (the song plays... and cuts out on a half-word)
